predictions.source_summary: User authentication state from Django request.user object, OTP device configuration state from django_otp.user_has_device()
predictions.sink_summary: Access control decision in dispatch() method that determines whether to grant access to protected views or redirect to permission denial
predictions.guard_summary: OTP verification check (user.is_verified()), device presence check (user_has_device), and configurable if_configured flag that allows bypass when no devices are configured
predictions.risk_pattern: Conditional OTP verification bypass that allows access if user has no configured OTP devices when if_configured=True, potentially weakening 2FA enforcement
predictions.context_summary: The test() method determines OTP verification requirements for views inheriting from OtpRequiredMixin. When if_configured=True, users without OTP devices can bypass verification, used in device management views like DeviceListView, DeviceCreateView etc.
